subject: Banking
title: Antitrust and Deal Blockers
description: One-minute skill: Antitrust and Deal Blockers.

hook.text: Microsoft's $69 billion Activision deal took 21 months to close because regulators in three countries tried to block it.

buildup.text: Antitrust regulators review mergers to prevent monopolies.

discovery.text: Companies offer remedies like selling divisions or licensing technology to win approval.

twist.text: Some deals die from regulatory exhaustion. Nvidia abandoned its $40 billion ARM acquisition after regulators stalled.

climax.text: Antitrust is the final gatekeaper of mergers. Even willing buyers and sellers can be stopped by government power.

punchline.text: 21 months to close, three countries fought it. Regulators shape deals.

quiz.question: Why did Nvidia's ARM acquisition fail?
options: Regulators in multiple countries stalled the deal until Nvidia gave up
